text:
Assistant B provides a complete, functional solution that meets all requirements: a simple HTML page with a button that, when clicked, displays a random joke from a list of four jokes. The code includes proper event handling, random selection, and DOM update to show the joke on the page. Assistant A’s code has several issues: the button lacks an ID so the event listener fails, the jokes are not random but sequential, the list contains six entries (not four distinct jokes), and the joke is only logged to the console instead of being displayed. Therefore, Assistant B is clearly better.

[[B]]
